map.由系统与外界熵变求熵产: Find entropy generation from system and surroundings entropy change
map.输入系统熵变与热源熵变，求熵产（应 ≥0）。: Enter the system entropy change and heat-source entropy change to find entropy generation (should be >=0).
map.📖 查看「由系统与外界熵变求熵产 使用指南」: View "Find entropy generation from system and surroundings entropy change" guide
map.S_gen = ΔS_sys + ΔS_surr ≥ 0。 系统 +10、环境: S_gen = DeltaS_sys + DeltaS_surr >= 0. System +10, surroundings -9 -> S_gen=+1.
map.系统熵变与环境熵变之和是否非负。: Whether the sum of system and surroundings entropy changes is non-negative.
map.检验过程是否满足第二定律。: Check whether a process satisfies the second law.
map.不可逆性量化（熵产越大损失越大）。: Quantify irreversibility (larger entropy generation means larger loss).
map.ΔS_sys=10, ΔS_surr=−9 J/K：S_gen=10+(−9)=: DeltaS_sys=10, DeltaS_surr=-9 J/K: S_gen=10+(-9)=1 J/K>=0, satisfying the second law.
map.若 S_gen<0 则过程不可能发生（如热量自发从冷到热）。: If S_gen<0 the process cannot occur (e.g. heat spontaneously flowing from cold to hot).
map.孤立系统总熵不减，S_gen≥0 是过程可行判据。: The total entropy of an isolated system does not decrease; S_gen>=0 is the criterion for process feasibility.
map.熵产对应作功能力损失（T0·S_gen），是㶲损失度量。: Entropy generation corresponds to lost work capability (T0 S_gen); it measures exergy destruction.
